QuestInfo.name: Tasty Mushroom Candy
QuestInfo.1: You tell Nina that Sen wants Mushroom Candy. She then takes ten out of her pocket and asks you to give those to him. Better go see #bSen#k now!
QuestInfo.2: When Sen received the Mushroom Candy, he seemed very grateful and even gave you a couple to enjoy.

0.0: So what did Sen want? What? Mushroom Candy? Haha... He was getting cavities so I told him not to eat any more candy. Well, he was good today, so I'll let him have some.
0.1: Here are 10 Mushroom Candies. Please give them to #bSen#k for me. Thanks in advance.

no.0: Eh...? You don't want to do it? I mean, you've helped me this far already...

1.0: Wow! She did make me Mushroom Candy! Yeah! Those are so sweet, and I really like them, you know! Thanks!

yes.0: Oh yeah, you should try some too. My sister always told me it's always better to share.

npc.0: You didn't go see #bSen#k yet? He must be eagerly waiting for the candy. Please go see him soon.

item.0: Hmmm? You haven't gone to see #bNina#k yet? I really want that Mushroom Candy... Yum!

lost.0: What? You lost the Mushroom Candy? Oh no... Where did you drop them? Sigh...oh well... I'll give you another one this time, so please don't lose them, okay?
